name: Roxann Murray
short_bio: Roxann Murray is a Tacoma photographer and multidisciplinary artist documenting community, nature and travel, with beadwork drawing on her Celtic and Nakoda/Dakota ancestry.

sources.label: Tacoma Arts Month: Tacoma Studio Tour 2026 artist map

biography: Roxann Murray is a photographer and multidisciplinary artist in Tacoma. Her photographs focus on pattern, color and candid portraits, and she also makes beadwork, digital collage and illustrations.

She studied Interdisciplinary Arts and Sciences at UW Tacoma, graduating in 2009 with a certificate of high scholarship, and has collaborated with the Indigenous Creatives Collective, National Nurses United and the City of Seattle's Office of Arts and Culture.
